items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But I'm wondering also about your other uncle John that played trumpet. [INTERVIEWEE] Well Johnny played. He played a long ride. He played with Tick Johnson out of Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: Very fine. Very fine bass player. And Willie Joseph was very fine. I worked at Alamo with him for three and a half years. I'm trying to think of what Morris is in a different band.

Well of course we can ask him some more. I didn't get to hear the interview. I wasn't there. But I hope we have most of the information on his life. But I'm wondering also about your other uncle John that played trumpet.
Well Johnny played. He played a long ride. He played with Tick Johnson out of Baton Rouge.
